16.1 Keyboard Shortcuts – Full Reference

The ABpE Portal supports a number of keyboard shortcuts for more efficient operation.

Key(s)FunctionAreaDescription
? Open help Global Opens the help modal with context-sensitive tips
/ Focus search field Global Sets focus to the global search bar
S Toggle statistics Dashboard Expands/collapses the statistics section in the dashboard
Q Quick Actions Dashboard Opens the Quick Actions section
Ctrl + S Save CV Editor Saves the current CV draft
Ctrl + E Export CV Editor Exports the CV as PDF or DOCX
Ctrl + K Focus TOC Documentation Sets focus to the table of contents
Esc Close Global Closes modal dialogs (help, settings)

16.2 API Endpoints Reference

The ABpE Portal offers several API layers. Here is the full reference of all available endpoints.

REST API (Django REST Framework)

EndpointMethodDescriptionAuthentication
/api/consultants/ GET, POST Consultant list, create consultant Session, Token
/api/consultants/{id}/ GET, PUT, DELETE Consultant details, update, delete Session, Token
/api/cvs/ GET, POST CV list, upload CV Session, Token
/api/emails/ GET Email list Session, Token

Simple JSON API

EndpointMethodDescriptionExample Response
/api/stats/ GET Statistics data {"consultants": 24000, "emails": 157, ...}
/api/system/ GET System status {"django": "online", "celery": "RUNNING", ...}
/api/available-languages/ GET Available languages {"languages": [{"code": "de", ...}], "current": "de"}
/api/set-language/ POST Switch language {"success": true, "language": "en"}
/api/user-settings/ GET, POST User settings {"theme": "dark", "language": "de"}

Component API

EndpointMethodDescription
/api/components/stats/ GET Statistics component (for dashboard)
/api/components/system/ GET System status component
/api/components/recent-consultants/ GET Recent consultants
/api/components/recent-emails/ GET Recent emails
/api/components/actions/ GET Quick Actions
/api/components/badge/email/ GET Email badge (unread)

16.3 module.json Fields – Full Reference

FieldTypeRequiredDescriptionExample
id string ✅ yes Unique module ID "cv_editor"
title string ✅ yes Display name (i18n key) "CV Editor"
icon string ❌ no Bootstrap Icon name (without bi-) "file-earmark-text"
route string ✅ yes/Navigation route (URL or URL name) "/cv-editor/"
order integer ❌ no (default: 999) Sort order in sidebar (small = top) 20
enabled boolean ❌ no (default: true) Module active/inactive true
badge string ❌ no Badge key for dynamic number (API) "pending_cvs"
roles array ❌ no Roles with access (empty = all) ["admin", "berater"]
static.css array ❌ no CSS files (relative to static/abpe_ui/css/) ["mod-cv-editor.css"]
static.js array ❌ no JS files (relative to static/abpe_ui/js/) ["mod-cv-editor.js"]
subpages array ❌ no Submenu items [{"id": "upload", "title": "Upload", "route": "/cv-editor/upload/"}]
icon_svg string ❌ no Custom SVG icon (path in assets/icons/) "cv-editor.svg"
